subject: POL-1000: how many times the notification deadline changed
body:
Hi, Tomas Vik from the SRE team here. Across all versions of the Change Management Policy, how often
was the notification deadline changed? A change is a revision whose value differs from the one
before.

The first revision setting the value is not a change; count only later reisions wehre the value
differs from the previous one.

Regards, Tomas Vik -- SRE
